newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore meet finalises 30,000-km telecom link.
newsitem.headline: Singapore meet finalises 30,000-km telecom link.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications (SingTel) said on Monday that 78 telecommunications administrations have finalised investments of US$1.2 billion in a 30,000-km (18,750 mile) long submarine cable system,

In a statement following the September 24-26 meeting of the administrations, SingTel said the main supply contract for the previously announced South East Asia-Middle East-Western Europe 3 (SEA-ME-WE3) submarine cable system is expected to be placed within the next three months.
The construction and maintenance agreement will be signed in early January 1997, SingTel said.
It is expected that the SEA-ME-WE3 cable, with 32 landing points ranging from Shanghai to the United Kingdom, will carry commercial traffic by December 1998.
